channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: U.S. economy unexpectedly loses 23,000 jobs in July
item.description: The Labor Department offered an update Friday morning on the U.S. jobs market. After lackluster hiring in June, forecasters had expected the report to show a modest pickup in July.

item.title: Supplements are a fast-growing industry, but there's little evidence on effectiveness
item.description: Supplements are a $70 billion industry that's growing fast. But there's little evidence that many supplements actually do what they promise.

item.title: Trump administration proposes sweeping changes for Head Start, worrying advocates
item.description: The Trump administration is proposing new standards for Head Start, the nation's early education program for low-income kids. States would have a lot more control, and that has advocates worried.

item.title: Trump signs new orders targeting birthright citizenship, weeks after SCOTUS ruling
item.description: President Trump signed two executive orders on Thursday, putting new limits on who is eligible for birthright citizenship. But legal experts expect both orders to be challenged.
